allocation_index_note: r remains the residual rank for the audited allocation sweep, including the 17/9984 Alg1 diagnostic at r=8. Capacity uses the separate budget index K and residual rank K-1.

capacity.feasibility: Require cost<=B on every instance; otherwise stop, never condition the median on feasible instances. With 17 atoms and n>=128, 2*m<=34<2n+1, hence every instance fits.
capacity.slack: B-actual_cost, reported per instance and in aggregates
capacity.line_dictionary_size: 2n+7: n causal columns, n offset diagonals, seven profiled bands
capacity.line_steps_allowed: min(floor(B/2),2n+7), finite-dictionary limit and unused cap explicit

statistics.primary: Imported phase24_p0_metrics.describe: median across all instances; percentile 95% CI from 2000 resampled whole-document blocks
statistics.secondary: Mean of document means, plus median/IQR of document means and their bootstrap intervals, all explicitly secondary
statistics.paired_test: Compute per-instance error difference; reduce each document to its median difference; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank across all 64 documents (zero_method=wilcox, asymptotic p)
statistics.paired_median_CI: Same imported describe on all paired instance differences, resampling whole documents
statistics.fraction_SVD_wins: Strict error_SVD<error_method on all head-document instances; also distinct (layer,head) fraction after within-head document median; exact ties and sensitivity at 1e-12 separately

ALT.claim: Five fixed iterations; no claim of convergence/global optimum
